name: Create Phonemic Sound Boxes Activity
description:
Create a phonemic awareness 'Sound Boxes' activity in ActivInspire for a Kindergarten class.

Your task:
1. Create a new flipchart with the title 'Sound Boxes' at the top.
2. Import the image of a Cat (located in /home/ga/Pictures/ActivInspire/cat.jpg) and place it on the canvas. Below the cat, draw exactly 3 square boxes (rectangles) to represent the 3 sounds in 'Cat'.
3. Import the image of a Frog (located in /home/ga/Pictures/ActivInspire/frog.jpg) and place it on the canvas. Below the frog, draw exactly 4 square boxes (rectangles) to represent the 4 sounds in 'Frog'.
4. Create a set of at least 5 red circular chips (using the shape tool) at the bottom of the page for students to use as counters.
5. Save the flipchart to '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/phonemic_awareness.flipchart'.
